approval.source: Owner message in this chat approving the proposed test boundary and requesting a full English specification and GitHub issue.
approval.primarySeam: Built public CLI, real local Git, independent Git expectations; real PTY for child selection.
behaviorGroups: Interactive selection and cancellation before staging or creation.
Exact explicit child choices and early invalid-request refusal.
Chosen-parent/current-parent and onto scope with selected descendants and unselected branch preservation.
Existing mandatory protection, independent protected siblings and changed-state rechecks.
Real selected conflict and fresh-process continuation without scope expansion.
Existing defaults, aliases, staging options and normal interaction/cwd policy.

authoredContract.value: one exact nonempty local direct-child branch name per occurrence
authoredContract.withoutExplicitChoices: terminal multiple-child menu; otherwise existing automatic/all-child rules
authoredContract.selectionTiming: before staging, checkout, branch/commit creation or insertion parent changes
authoredContract.status: specified; not implemented or accepted by current baseline CLI

unchangedPolicies: Current all-over-patch precedence and existing patch/dirty-work refusals.
Current immediate nonzero conflict outcome and bounded continuation/abort semantics.
Existing MCP tools, envelope and publication authority.
Legacy saved-state compatibility; no metadata migration.
publicationScope: Specification, supporting note and evidence only; no implementation, PR, tests or CI.
